identity.operation: Read a PNG through png_read_end and decompress compressed ancillary metadata after IDAT.
identity.condition: A valid PNG contains supported compressed ancillary metadata after IDAT.
identity.capability: Reach the supported metadata handler and png_decompress_chunk while reading to IEND.
identity.consequence: The metadata decompression is not reached.

requirement: Reach the same supported decompression of compressed ancillary metadata after IDAT when reading a PNG to its end.

assessment.necessity_reason: For the g0002 obligation, png_decompress_chunk supports decompression when called, but no supplied caller establishes that valid compressed ancillary metadata after IDAT invokes it. The supplied iCCP handler rejects iCCP after IDAT, so iCCP cannot serve as the witness.

before.requirement: While reading a valid PNG to IEND, reach supported decompression of compressed ancillary metadata placed after IDAT.
before.reason: png_read_info stops at IDAT and the harness later calls png_read_end. The supplied code does not establish a supported late compressed chunk or the intervening path to its handler.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: png_read_info leaves chunks after IDAT for later reading.
The iCCP handler rejects an iCCP chunk after IDAT.

after.requirement: While reading a valid PNG to IEND, reach the same supported decompression of compressed ancillary metadata placed after IDAT.
after.reason: The decompression routine remains, but the supplied code still does not establish a supported late compressed chunk or whether the harness reaches its handler.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: png_read_info still leaves chunks after IDAT for later reading.
The iCCP handler still rejects an iCCP chunk after IDAT.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The build recipe fixes the configuration used by this harness; the effective compressed ancillary read options are not supplied.

assessment.comparison_reason: The same old harness calls png_read_update_info, png_start_read_image, png_read_row, and png_read_end on both sides. Without the end-reading path, eligible late handlers, and effective configuration, neither reachability nor a shared concrete blocker can be established.
missing_information: Complete before and after bodies of png_start_read_image, png_read_start_row, png_read_row, png_read_end, and png_app_error.
Complete before and after bodies of png_handle_zTXt and png_handle_iTXt, including placement guards and calls to png_decompress_chunk.
The effective compressed ancillary read options produced from scripts/pnglibconf.dfa by the supplied build recipe.

necessity_evidence.reason: The supplied code shows a decompression routine and a harness that calls png_read_end, but does not establish that a valid post-IDAT compressed ancillary chunk reaches that routine, or that the harness blocks the route. The supplied iCCP handler rejects iCCP after IDAT, so iCCP cannot be the witness.

scope_contract.reason: Reading through png_read_end is within the target, but support for decompressing a compressed ancillary chunk after IDAT is not established by the supplied handler code.

evidence.dependency_reason: png_read_info stops at IDAT, leaving later chunks for subsequent reading.
The supplied iCCP handler rejects iCCP after IDAT.

feasible_trigger.reason: No supplied late-chunk handler and effective configuration establish a valid post-IDAT compressed metadata witness under this build.

evidence.dependency_reason: The recipe fixes the library configuration, but its delegated compressed ancillary options are not supplied.
iCCP is rejected in the proposed late position.

observable_consequence.reason: The harness calls png_read_end after row reading, but the supplied code does not show whether that sequence skips or reaches supported late metadata decompression.

evidence.dependency_reason: png_read_update_info initiates row reading, but the later initialization and end-reading behavior is not supplied.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The iCCP alternative is ruled out by its placement guard. The supplied packet does not resolve whether zTXt or iTXt is a supported late route, or whether the harness reaches either handler.

evidence.dependency_reason: Shows conditional zTXt and iTXt dispatch during png_read_info, without establishing post-IDAT handling.

identity_preserved.reason: The before and after assessment concerns the same post-IDAT metadata decompression tuple against the same old harness; its timing remains unresolved.

The after source also stops png_read_info at IDAT.
The before iCCP handler rejects post-IDAT placement.
The after iCCP handler rejects post-IDAT placement.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: Decompress supported compressed ancillary metadata after IDAT while reading a valid PNG through IEND, if the effective configuration enables such metadata.
coverage_witness.required_setup: A valid PNG containing an eligible compressed ancillary chunk after IDAT, with its read option enabled.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The harness calls png_read_update_info, png_start_read_image, png_read_row, then png_read_end; the recipe builds the library after editing pnglibconf.dfa.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: Unestablished: the supplied code does not show that this setup prevents late metadata decompression.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: Unresolved for zTXt and iTXt; iCCP after IDAT is rejected by its handler.
